E001.title: Unsupported Project
E001.message: This project is not supported. ReactCraft needs Vite 7 or 8, React 18 or 19 and Tailwind CSS 4.

reasons.tailwindVersion: Tailwind CSS version is not supported.

E002.title: Server Init Failed
E002.message: ReactCraft could not start. Check the terminal for details.

E003.title: Workspace Load Failed
E003.message: The project file .reactcraft/workspace.json could not be read.

E011.title: Permission Error
E011.message: Access was refused: the operating system denied it, or the project is not trusted yet.

reasons.untrusted: The project is not trusted yet.

E012.title: Path Security Violation
E012.message: This path is outside the allowed folders.

reasons.outsideRoot: Path is outside the project root.
reasons.uncOrDevicePath: UNC or device path is not allowed.
reasons.alternateDataStream: Alternate data stream path is not allowed.
reasons.reservedName: Path name is reserved by the operating system.
reasons.driveRoot: A drive root cannot be a project; pick or create a subfolder.
reasons.homeDir: Your home folder cannot be a project; pick a subfolder.
reasons.systemFolder: This is a system folder; ReactCraft does not use it.

E013.title: Internal Error
E013.message: Something went wrong inside ReactCraft. Details are in the terminal log.

E014.title: Unauthorized
E014.message: This session is invalid or has expired. Open ReactCraft again from the link shown in the terminal.

E015.title: Not Found
E015.message: The requested item was not found.

reasons.commandMismatch: Install command does not match the configured package manager.
reasons.cannotMatchProjectRoot: Backend directory cannot match the project root.
reasons.duplicateBackend: A backend already exists for this path.
reasons.notJsx: Inserted JSX snippet is not valid.
reasons.moveIntoSelf: Cannot move an element into itself or its descendants.
reasons.notSameParent: Elements must share the same parent element.
reasons.nothingToUnwrap: Element has no children to unwrap.
reasons.pathExists: A page with this URL path already exists.
reasons.nameExists: Component name already exists in routes.
reasons.lastPage: Cannot delete the last page of the project.
reasons.indexPage: Cannot change the path of an index page.
reasons.notConvention: Project does not follow the standard routes.tsx convention.
reasons.designDirs: Design directories must be within the source directory and cannot nest or overlap.

E017.title: Source Changed
E017.message: The source code changed elsewhere since it was read. It was reloaded.

reasons.moved: Element was moved or deleted in the source code.
reasons.valueChanged: Attribute value changed in the source code.

E018.title: Busy
E018.message: The project is busy or open in another session.

E020.title: Timeout
E020.message: The task took too long and was stopped.

E021.title: Not Configured
E021.message: Something required is missing: open a project, or install the editor or package manager.

E023.title: Source Not Editable
E023.message: This element cannot be edited visually. Open it in your editor.

reasons.classExpression: The className attribute uses a dynamic expression.
reasons.textExpression: Text content uses a JSX expression.
reasons.textMixed: Text contains a mix of static text and expressions.
reasons.selfClosing: Self-closing tag cannot contain direct text.
reasons.attrExpression: Attribute value is a dynamic expression.
reasons.outsideSource: Element is outside the allowed source directory.
reasons.tooLarge: Source file exceeds the maximum editable size limit.
reasons.notJsxFile: File is not a valid JSX or TSX file.
reasons.rootElement: Cannot remove or duplicate the root element of a component.
reasons.loopRoot: Cannot remove or duplicate the root element of a loop.
reasons.expressionChild: Element is inside a dynamic expression; edit it in your editor.
reasons.componentSlot: Component receives children via prop; cannot insert directly into its template.
reasons.componentTag: Cannot unwrap an uppercase component tag.
reasons.componentNotFound: Page component declaration or file could not be found.

E024.title: Edit Breaks Source
E024.message: The change would break the source code, so nothing was written.

E025.title: Dev Server Error
E025.message: The dev server of the project could not start or stopped.

reasons.portInUse: Dev server port is already in use.
reasons.timeout: Dev server timed out during startup.

E026.title: Agent Not Available
E026.message: No AI agent is installed or signed in on this computer.

reasons.notInstalled: AI agent CLI is not installed.
reasons.notLoggedIn: Not logged in to the AI agent account.

E027.title: Agent Run Failed
E027.message: The AI agent stopped with an error.

network.title: Network Error
network.message: Cannot reach the ReactCraft server. Is it still running?
